name: KALUKI
description: Kaluki (also spelled Kalooki) is a widely played European variant of Rummy, characterized by its use of two 52-card decks plus Jokers. Primarily played for points over multiple hands, it features a 51-point initial meld threshold and a distinctive 'Joker Exchange' rule where players can 'rescue' wild cards from the board.

content.text: Kaluki (also spelled Kalooki) is a widely played European variant of Rummy, characterized by its use of two 52-card decks plus Jokers. Primarily played for points over multiple hands, it features a 51-point initial meld threshold and a distinctive 'Joker Exchange' rule where players can 'rescue' wild cards from the board.

Believed to be a mid-20th century evolution of earlier Rummy games like Rummikub (the tile version) and standard 500 Rummy. The name likely derives from the Hungarian or Eastern European 'Kalooki' variants.
106 cards. Two standard 52-card decks plus 2 Jokers. Suits are Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades.
Standard cards, score sheet, chips or counters for stakes (optional).
Each player receives 13 cards dealt singly. The next card is turned face-up to start the discard pile; remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Kalooki 40 (British): Initial meld requirement is 40 points instead of 51. More common in British clubs and faster-paced.
Kalooki 51 (North American): Standard North American version requiring 51-point initial meld. More strategic and defensive.
South African Kaluki: Uses 4 Jokers and has a 7-round contract structure with different opening requirements each round.
